knownLimits: User manual acceptance remains pending; development checks are not user sign-off.
Current route/entity/query lifecycle only; no global unread, OS notifications, sound or cross-tab state.
Uncertain own inbound identity can remain pending without authoritative send/cancel evidence; no historical scanner.
Unseen external sequence runs which start and finish between existing snapshots are not newly tracked.
Scope journal retains distinct message identities until scope disposal; memory grows during long continuous sessions.
Legacy coarse directory events without projection evidence remain possible range updates.
Current scope snapshots plus related trusted interaction prove only the displayed target or explicit current range, never reading every underlying row.
No claims for OS sleep scheduling, all browsers, all modal/disconnection combinations, real gateway/model behavior or optional full C3 extension.
